core.description: Globs (relative to this file) for functional-core files that must stay pure.

shell.description: Globs for imperative-shell files (boundary parsers, interpreters, wiring). Shown to Claude as context.

exclude.description: Extra globs to skip. Tests (including Python test_*.py, *_test.py and conftest.py), testdata and .d.ts files are always skipped.

mode.description: deny: block edits that add effects and ask before new fe:allow exceptions. warn: allow them and add the report as context.

stopCheck.description: changed: at the end of a turn, re-check core files changed during the turn (needs git). off: disable.

profile.description: How much of the model applies. core: pure step function, sum types and property tests. service: core plus boundary, interpreter, failure classes, capabilities and contract tests. distributed: service plus outbox, inbox, timers, unknown outcomes with fencing, replay and chaos tests. Used by design, test and the reviewer.

designDir.description: Folder (relative to this file) for design documents written by /functional-effect:design and read by test and review.

verify.description: Command run at the end of a turn that changed core files, e.g. the core's property tests. Runs only after the user approves it with /functional-effect:verify; changing it requires approving again.

forbidImports.description: Extra import paths/prefixes forbidden in core files (Python: dotted module names such as "numpy").

allowImports.description: Import paths/prefixes always allowed in core files, even if forbidden by default.

forbidCalls.description: Extra JavaScript regular expressions matched against code (comments and strings removed).
